title: Product-Action Source Current Derivation
starting_point: V1694.0 required rho_P^oplus to be derived from product action variation, not event projector current.
claim_boundary: Mathematical derivation only. No execution, no retained field-law validation.

product_action.meaning: Measures faithfulness of retained recombination product under connection transport.

variation_split.source_current: J_oplus = residual variation caused by support/source variation of product domain, weights, and retained test-pair ledger
variation_split.key_correction: rho_oplus is not event labels and not arbitrary E_event projection; it is the source remainder of δI_oplus after stationary and boundary terms are removed.

expanded_sources: variation of retained pair set T_p
variation of source/access support S that changes admissible product pairs
variation of provenance/order incidence Π that changes pair admissibility or orientation
not_allowed: Σ Φ_oplus(E_event) without product-action variation support
source current inserted as correction term

operational_definition.for_execution: rho_var^oplus is computed by finite or analytic source-variation derivative of I_oplus with A frozen and boundary Q removed.
operational_definition.test: Perturb S/Pi support variables that determine T_p and ω_xy; measure induced dual covector on product residuals.
operational_definition.gate: rho_var must beat label-only and event-projector currents under nulls.

source_free_special_case.condition: δ_support I_oplus = 0 and pair ledger T_p,ω_xy,S,Π are frozen/inactive
source_free_special_case.rule: May only be tested if support audit confirms source variation is zero.
